db_ambiguous_player_join.definition: More than one prior roster or stats player matches the portal identity.

db_impact_source_unavailable.definition: The player joined but a required prior team-game or impact source was unavailable.

db_player_join_unresolved.definition: The prior source-team roster is covered, but this portal player did not join to it.

db_position_conflict.definition: The matched prior roster position group differs from the portal DB group.

db_source_team_uncovered.definition: The prior roster has no matching source-team row; source absence and team-name mismatch cannot be separated with committed payloads.

historical_aggregate_null.definition: The retrospective research aggregate has no numeric offensive value despite a covered portal season.

offense_ambiguous_player_join.definition: Historical player audit found multiple eligible prior usage matches.

offense_applicability_unproven.definition: Prior offensive participation cannot be determined from the audited usage and stats evidence.

offense_source_team_mismatch.definition: Historical player audit found a prior usage row under another source team.

offense_usage_join_unresolved.definition: An applicable offensive transfer has no resolved prior usage; the 2026 team aggregate does not retain the player-level join cause.

offense_usage_row_absent.definition: Historical player audit found applicable participation but no prior usage row.

repair_class_definitions.candidate_repair: A pipeline or identity-control repair is plausible from the committed evidence, subject to source confirmation.
repair_class_definitions.unresolved: The committed derived artifacts cannot establish whether source data or a safe repair exists.
